parts:
Dear R-INLA developer team,
I am new to R-INLA except for taking half-day training in 2018. I working on spatiotemporal modeling of the weekly number of malaria cases in Amhara region, Ethiopia which a real spatiotemporal data by taking estimated population sizes of districts as an offset.

1. R-INLA was installed from the R-INLA website using the code in R:
 install.packages("INLA",
repos = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable", dep = TRUE)

2. When I checked whether it is updated or not using: inla.upgrade()
 : It reported that It is the latest versions.

3. After importing data from excel and generating the spatial weight matrix: Then the formula is defined as follows :model:  git=b0+ui+vi+(b1+di)t

```{r}
Dat$w_week<-Dat$T
Dat$FiD1<-Dat$FiD
Dat$Pop<-log(Dat$Population)
attach(Dat)
formula1<- TM~1+f(FiD, model="bym",graph=Amhara.adj, constr=TRUE)+ f(FiD1,w_week , model="iid",constr=TRUE)+w_week
model1<- inla(formula1,family="poisson",data=Dat,E=Pop, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),control.fixed = list(prec.intercept=1),
control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))
``` 
  
After running this chunk of code, I would get the following error messages

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully. If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
3.
stop("The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.\n If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.")
2.
inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()
1.
inla(formula1, family = "poisson", data = Dat, E = Pop, control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE), control.fixed = list(prec.intercept = 1), control.compute = list(dic = TRUE))

I didn't find problems with the code. Would you please suggest solutions for these issues?
Kind Regards,

--

Teshager,  
PhD candidate at Bahir Dar University
Bahir Dar, Ethiopia

email: tesha...@gmail.com

H
